sentiment: The things worth keeping keep working in the quiet, long after the last signal fades.

stories.title: Smart home devices should work without the internet
stories.summary: A house is a local fact. The lights, the heat, the door — none of them needed a server in another state. Rebuilding automation around that truth is not nostalgia, it is remembering who the house belongs to.

stories.title: .name Grandfathered
stories.summary: A domain held for decades because someone kept paying attention. Permanence on the internet is not granted, it is maintained — a small recurring act of care that outlasts everyone's predictions.

stories.title: Protecting SSH Keys with macOS Secure Enclave
stories.summary: Keeping a secret in hardware means it never has to travel. Trust gets smaller, quieter, and closer to home — a key that cannot leave is a key that cannot be taken.
